area: testbed repair: editor schema 63 and the camera-path editor actions

find.consumer_evidence: keystone's own suite refers to EDITOR_SCHEMA_VERSION symbolically, so it cannot detect a consumer that pins a stale literal; only the testbed can

read: keystone/schema.py EDITOR_SCHEMA_VERSION and the new EDITOR_ACTIONS entries
killed: deleting the pin: the testbed exists to catch exactly this drift
asserting against the imported constant on both sides: a constant-to-constant assert passes even when Keystone ships a breaking change
relaxing to '>= 62': it would accept a rollback and would not name the actions the editor gained
analyze.survivor: pin the literal 63 and require the four new camera-path actions by name, so the testbed states the editor contract instead of observing it
